expectation: Membrane or fibre-like stain on vessel endothelium and on CD34+ stromal fibroblasts. It should form a dense network in the submucosa and lamina propria, outline vessels and connective-tissue septa, and spare the epithelium. Moderately common.
observed: A: a dense yellow fibrous network fills the submucosa and runs along septa in the muscle layer; the mucosal epithelium is dim. B/C: epithelial fields with sparse puncta only. D: elongated membrane-outlined spindle cells. E: a few CD34 spots sit on CD31 vessels; most CD31 is unlit.
why: Strong fibrous stromal and perivascular network confined to the submucosa and septa, sparing the epithelium, which is the expected CD34 pattern.
notes: CD34 lights a fibrous stromal network in the submucosa and the septa between muscle bundles, with spindle-shaped cells in D. The epithelium stays dim. In E it overlaps only some CD31 vessels, as the subset relation expects.
